mentions.name: Chaotic
mentions.description: A high-performance 3D game engine and editor written in Rust that targets WebAssembly and WebGL2, delivering near-native performance and console-quality visuals directly in the browser.
mentions.source_excerpt: We’re building Chaotic, a high-performance 3D game engine and editor written in Rust. It targets WebAssembly and WebGL2, making it possible to deliver near-native performance and console-quality visuals directly in the browser.
